source: Compiled from ICAR Soil Classification standards, NBSS&LUP Technical Bulletins, and Indian state agriculture university soil survey reports
disclaimer: These are typical reference ranges for broad soil categories in the Indian context. Actual values vary significantly by location, depth, management history, and season. These ranges are NOT predictions from the uploaded image.

ph.notes: Varies from slightly acidic in upper Gangetic plains to alkaline in lower reaches

nitrogen.notes: Generally medium to high; varies with organic matter content

phosphorus.notes: Low to medium; phosphorus fixation common

potassium.notes: Medium to high in most alluvial plains

moisture.notes: Good water retention due to fine texture

electrical_conductivity.notes: Can be high in saline-alkaline areas

ph.notes: Typically alkaline due to high base saturation and calcareous nature

nitrogen.notes: Low due to sparse vegetation and rapid organic matter decomposition

phosphorus.notes: Variable; phosphorus often locked in calcium compounds

moisture.notes: Very low water retention; sandy texture dominant

ph.notes: Neutral to moderately alkaline; high in calcium and magnesium

nitrogen.notes: Low to medium; high clay content limits nitrogen availability

phosphorus.notes: Generally low; phosphorus fixation in calcareous clays

potassium.notes: High potassium from montmorillonite clay minerals

moisture.notes: Excellent water retention from smectite clays; shrink-swell behavior

organic_carbon.notes: Low to medium; dark color from titaniferous minerals, not organic matter

electrical_conductivity.notes: Can accumulate salts in vertisol profiles

ph.notes: Acidic due to intense leaching of bases under tropical conditions

nitrogen.notes: Low to medium; rapid organic matter turnover

phosphorus.notes: Very low; phosphorus strongly fixed by iron and aluminium oxides

moisture.notes: Moderate; depends on iron oxide cementation

organic_carbon.notes: Medium in surface layers under forest cover

ph.notes: Acidic; high rainfall leads to leaching of cations

nitrogen.notes: High due to accumulation of organic matter in cool conditions

phosphorus.notes: Low to medium; limited by acidic conditions

potassium.notes: Medium; depends on parent rock composition

moisture.notes: High moisture from precipitation; good humus content aids retention

organic_carbon.notes: High to very high; slow decomposition in cool climate

ph.notes: Slightly acidic to neutral; derived from crystalline and metamorphic rocks

moisture.notes: Low to moderate; porous and well-drained

ph.notes: Acidic to neutral; hydrated iron oxide gives yellow color

phosphorus.notes: Low; similar to red soils with iron oxide fixation

moisture.notes: Moderate; better than red soils in humid regions
